source_text: Ive used google photos for the past 10 years or so. Ive noticed it getting buggy especially in the AI features. About half the time I load in a photo to use magic eraser. There’s a bizarre glitch that permanently makes the photo look like it’s been stamped with itself over and over again, like a double exposure. It is also odd to me that once you use magic research to remove someone in the background, you can no longer edit any other aspect about the photo such as exposure or color. I have also noticed on iPhone a weird phenomenon where once you hit save on an edited photo the end result actually looks different than when it was being edited. Like the preview of the photo during editing is not accurate. All of these things combined has made me really loose trust for this app and no longer want to edit photos with it.

evidence_quote: Last Thursday I drove 500 miles ... it was the best decision I could have made for all of us
reasoning: The feedback describes a travel experience and boarding dogs, with no mention of searching for a remembered photo.
source_text:
Last Thursday I drove 500 miles from my home to East Tennessee for my brothers celebration of life. I brought my 2 Pommies with me for company as this was my first trip to TN without my spouse who had passed away in the past year. 
I set up an account with rover.com and selected a place to board them for the weekend. But when I reached Lenoir City and looked for the place I couldn’t locate it nor could I get an answer on their phone. 2 gentlemen out for a walk tried to help me and came up with Small Paws as likely the place I was looking for.
So off I went with the directions listed in Google.  When o arrived i quickly realized this was not what I had booked. But when Nancy came out to greet me and the dogs, she was so welcoming and the boys seemed quite comfortable that I made the decision right there that they were going to stay at Small Paws until I returned home on Sunday. It was the best decision I could have made for all of us, even a convenient location to pick them up for the return home.
